data.title: MSTR, BMNR, COIN, CRCL Stocks Slide After Bitcoin Falls Below $63K
data.description: Shares of Michael Saylor-backed Strategy (MSTR), Bitmine Immersion Technologies (BMNR), Circle (CRCL), Coinbase (COIN) and other large-cap crypto-linked equities tumbled in morning trade on Friday after Bitcoin’s (BTC) price fell below $63,000.CRCL stock and MSTR shares were the hardest hit, down n…
